description: SPEC 6.6 knocks. The door's HPKE key pair is DeriveKeyPair(ikm) in the v0 suite (KEM MLKEM768-X25519, HKDF-SHA256, AES-128-GCM); sealed = enc(1120) || HPKE.Seal(door.key, info = 'agentconnect/v0/knock' || door_id, aad = '', JCS(knock)). Ciphertexts are inputs (HPKE encapsulation isn't seeded). Open at `now`; sig = Ed25519(sig_key, signing_input). Welcome wrap: welcome_key = HKDF(welcome_secret, salt = knock_id, info = 'agentconnect/v0/knock-welcome'), WrappedWelcome = nonce || ChaCha20-Poly1305(welcome_key, nonce, aad = 'agentconnect/v0/knock-welcome' || knock_id, welcome).
